PIK3CA Wild-Type Cohort On July 28, 2025, we announced topline data from the WT cohort of the VIKTORIA-1 Phase 3 clinical trial and on October 18, 2025, at the European Society of Medical Oncology ("ESMO") Congress, we presented additional efficacy and safety results from this cohort.

The analysis found that patients treated with the gedatolisib triplet and doublet were 2x and 1.5x more likely to survive without disease progression or death, respectively, compared to imlunestrant plus abemaciclib. 29 PIK3CA Mutant-Type Cohort On May 1, 2026, we announced positive topline results from Study 2 (the PIK3CA MT cohort) of the VIKTORIA-1 Phase 3 trial, and on June 2, 2026, in a late-breaking abstract oral session at the American Society of Clinical Oncology (“ASCO”) Annual Meeting, we presented detailed efficacy and safety results from this cohort.
We expect topline data for this group to be available by the end of 2028 or the first half of 2029.
